title: Office Battlefield - Good Boy
summary: Jamin apologizes for the ticket title and public jokes. Jason treats the apology as proof he was right, answers with "good boy," and keeps escalating while David urges him to stop.

portal.scene: Jason faces an apology letter marked GOOD BOY beside a heavy rubber stamp and office phone, while messages and coworkers circle the desk.
portal.motif: An apology treated as a victory stamp
